title: Bahla Fort
geometryBasis: Current mapped fort boundary registers the occupied platform. Nineteenth-century photographs show the tower taper and relationship to the enclosure. Original Copernicus data fixes elevation at the southwestern foot of the enclosure.
sectionBasis: Miles’s original plates constrain the rubble footing, large earthen curtain, rounded wind tower, tall arched gallery, flat roofs and irregular parapets. Official heritage records identify the three building groups.
limitations: The 1885 exterior uses the standing enclosure as its geographic outline. The placement and height of inner terraces, courtyards and obscured elevations are approximate.
Only the main fort is represented. The Friday Mosque, separate settlement buildings and longer oasis wall are outside its scope.
